newsitem.title: UK: Marriott launches hotel apartment brand.
newsitem.headline: Marriott launches hotel apartment brand.

text.p: Marriott International said on Thursday it was launching a new hotel brand to cater for business executives who stay in cities for 30 days or more.
The brand will be called Marriott Executive Residences and the first one will open in Budapest later this year.

Ed Fuller, managing director of Marriott Lodging International, told reporters at a London briefing the brand was aimed at mid-level to senior executives in industries such as banking, professional services or manufacturing.

"When you are starting what may be the career assignment of a lifetime, the last thing you want to think about are details like personal housing. You want to get on with the job," Fuller said. "Marriott Executive Residences will take the guesswork out of deciding where to stay," he added.

Marriott, the international hotel group based in Washington D.C., plans to open at least four of the properties a year and aims to have around 25 within the next five years. It intends to offer owners management or franchise contracts.
It will target emerging markets in the Pacific Rim and eastern Europe as well as cities in other parts of Asia, western Europe, Latin America and the U.S.
The residences will normally be situated adjacent to Marriott hotels in major towns and cities.
Lease rates will vary by market but are expected to mirror those of a five-star hotel in the relevant city. Discounts may be available for stays of over 30 days.
The residences will offer studios and one, two and three bedroom apartments. They will have fully-equipped kitchens and telephone lines.
